name: things3pp-cloud
description: Hosted Things web app + remote MCP server on Cloudflare Workers. Deployed with `things3pp cloud deploy`.

scripts.build: cf build && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R .cloudflare/output dist/output
scripts.typecheck: cf workers types >/dev/null && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.app.json
